added:
Reuse the same Anki card design across decks: keep a note type's templates, CSS
and media in one directory and load it for normal or Cloze cards. The examples
use Rust; Python and Node.js load bundles with `NoteType.from_bundle` and
`NoteType.fromBundle` (see the [Python API](python/api.md#models-and-templates)
and [Node API](node/api.md#immutable-models)).

在多个牌组中复用同一套 Anki 卡片设计：把笔记类型的模板、CSS 和媒体放在同一目录中，用于普通卡片或 Cloze 卡片。示例使用 Rust；Python 和 Node.js 分别通过 `NoteType.from_bundle` 和 `NoteType.fromBundle` 加载模板包，参见 [Python API](../python/api.md#models-and-templates) 和 [Node API](../node/api.md#immutable-models)。

removed:
A Basic note has a front and back. A Cloze note generates one card for each
supported deletion number. This example creates two notes and three cards.
added:
Generate Anki Basic (question-and-answer) and Cloze (fill-in-the-blank) cards
from code instead of adding them one at a time in Anki. A Basic note has a front
and back. A Cloze note generates one card for each supported deletion number.
This Rust example creates two notes and three cards. Python and Node.js provide
the same `Note.basic` and `Note.cloze` constructors; see the
[Python API](python/api.md#project-and-note-values) and
[Node API](node/api.md#project-and-notes).

removed: Basic 笔记有正面和背面。Cloze 笔记针对每个受支持的填空编号生成一张卡片。本例创建两条笔记和三张卡片。
added: 用代码批量生成 Anki 问答（Basic）卡片和 Cloze 填空（挖空）卡片，无需在 Anki 中逐张添加。Basic 笔记有正面和背面。Cloze 笔记针对每个受支持的填空编号生成一张卡片。本例用 Rust 创建两条笔记和三张卡片。Python 和 Node.js 提供相同的 `Note.basic` 与 `Note.cloze` 构造方法，参见 [Python API](../python/api.md#project-and-note-values) 和 [Node API](../node/api.md#project-and-notes)。

Package images and audio into generated Anki cards, such as vocabulary cards
with pronunciation audio or diagram questions. Anki Forge copies the files you
provide into the APKG; creating the audio or images, for example with
text-to-speech, requires a separate tool. The examples use Rust; batch import
below also shows the Python and Node.js calls.
把图片和音频打包进生成的 Anki 卡片，例如带发音音频的单词卡或示意图题目。Anki Forge 将你提供的文件复制进 APKG；生成音频或图片（例如语音合成）需要使用其他工具。示例使用 Rust；下文的批量导入也给出了 Python 和 Node.js 调用。

removed:
Create a structured image-occlusion note from an owned image and rectangles.
Each mask needs a stable key that continues to identify the same region through
later versions. The note joins a project through the ordinary `add(key, note)`
path.
added:
Generate Anki Image Occlusion cards programmatically: supply an image and
rectangle coordinates, and Anki Forge builds a note with one card per mask,
ready to import. Use it to produce diagram questions in batches without drawing
masks in Anki's editor. It does not detect labels in the image; you provide the
coordinates.

Create a structured image-occlusion note from an owned image and rectangles.
Each mask needs a stable key that continues to identify the same region through
later versions. The note joins a project through the ordinary `add(key, note)`
path. These examples use Rust; Python and Node.js provide the same builder in
the [Python API](python/api.md#media-and-occlusion) and
[Node API](node/api.md#media-and-image-occlusion).

removed: 使用拥有所有权的图像与矩形创建结构化图片遮挡笔记。每个遮罩需要稳定键，在后续版本中继续标识同一区域。笔记通过普通 `add(key, note)` 加入项目。
added: 用代码批量生成 Anki 图片遮挡（图片挖空）卡片：提供图片和矩形坐标，Anki Forge 生成笔记，每个遮罩对应一张卡片，可直接导入。适合批量制作示意图题目，无需在 Anki 编辑器中逐个绘制遮罩。本库不会自动识别图中的标签，坐标由你提供。

使用拥有所有权的图像与矩形创建结构化图片遮挡笔记。每个遮罩需要稳定键，在后续版本中继续标识同一区域。笔记通过普通 `add(key, note)` 加入项目。示例使用 Rust；Python 和 Node.js 提供相同的构建器，参见 [Python API](../python/api.md#media-and-occlusion) 和 [Node API](../node/api.md#media-and-image-occlusion)。

Publish corrections or new cards for an Anki deck you have already distributed.
Stable note IDs help Anki Forge and Anki recognize existing notes instead of
treating them as new ones; Anki's import settings and newer local edits still
affect what changes.
为已经分发的 Anki 牌组发布修正或新增卡片。稳定笔记 ID 帮助 Anki Forge 和 Anki 识别已有笔记，而不是把它们当成新笔记；Anki 导入设置与较新的本地编辑仍会影响最终变化。

openIssues.description: The Models and templates section documents `NoteType.from_bundle(path, limits=MediaLimits())`, but the published ankiforge 0.3.1 signature is keyword-only: `def from_bundle(path: PathInput, *, limits: MediaLimits = MediaLimits()) -> NoteType:` (bindings/python/src/ankiforge/notetype.py at the 0.3.1 tag and in the installed wheel). Executed with the published package: `NoteType.from_bundle(path, MediaLimits())` raises “TypeError: NoteType.from_bundle() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given”; `limits=MediaLimits()` works. The same table already writes `Media.file(path, *, limits=MediaLimits())` with the `*`. The new template-bundles opening (both locales) now links readers to this section, so the spelling deserves `*, limits=`. Documentation precision only; the default call shown elsewhere is correct, and no new sentence is wrong.
